title: STNFS v11: record walk per canonical a-run (rec7) on the v10 core: 119.511232653739

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the complete STNFS algorithm of proof.md, DESCENT.md and STORAGE.md returns Q with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P (Q=[a]Q0 from two GT logarithms; z=1 handled directly) with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under the disclosed heuristics H1-H5, and all classical work is bounded by a global meter at 2^119.511232653739 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000 instructions); upper-rounded ledger rows sum to 2^119.511232653738132. Relation collection (v8's sieve, box-shared certified norm bounds, band strip charged at each row's norm size and f-first early abort, slice layout charged per suffix-box entry at the measured 28.17 Ir plus 2^21 per slice, primes in [2^52, 2^63) walked once per canonical a-run (rec7.c: REC7_TAB step reading at h' = h x run cells / row cells plus 2 Ir per record, setup6 once per run, 99% of the saving credited, two reduced bases per ideal a 2^68.3 row); v9 prices the line path by the public slice12 line walk measured on random (p, s) pairs (table by points per coset h, each entry >= the pooled cost + 2 SE of its group, cap 17.2 for h >= 2^18.81), and primes in [2^63, 2^64) on the measured wide12.c path (record table of the public slice12 x 1.01, setup6w, wide lattices a 2^70.6 row)): excess 1.05, theta=2326/8000 sized on pool B (seeds 7-10) and judged once on a fresh pool D (seeds 41-44, 656,000 draws; pre-registered rule), retained relations >= 2^63.6016 (0.0798 bits above 1.05 U, pool SE 0.0177), 99.9% ECM, X2=2^64, slacks (295, 226), work priced on pools B, C, D with allowance 1.0047 = 1 + 2 SE rounded up: <= 2^119.215030141 units. Linear algebra: filtering at excess 1.05, purge target 1e-4 U (64 runs, 2^12..2^18), N(300)/U charged 0.03943 = the larger of mean + 2 SE at 2^17 and 2^18, rounded up: N = 2^58.7868 < 8 x 2^56 (eight owners, row tail counted 1,424, charged 1,430); unit share charged 0.87 (below every measured value), Krylov 13.21 and Horner 20.9 per entry, 97 per dense term, 420 per reduction, 60 per projection term, blocks (28, 5): <= 2^116.981242966 units; generator <= 2^107.555167552. Descent (v7 plan, sub-bin yields, lazy evaluation) at the judged pool's inputs (relations 63.566 = estimate minus 2 SE, mean norms 740.8/499.4): expected two-log work <= 2^112.4402; meter 2^113.156048; Markov abort <= 0.6088472; boot failure 1.475e-05 per log, expected nodes 2^15.70, node abort 2^-11.60, repeats 2^-10.70, 2/r charged. Preprocessing, failures, transfers, verification and output are included; nothing amortized; memory at most 2^105 bytes. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Bounded audit of recorded full-recurrence evidence, upward-rounded ledger and success, unchanged prime-window endpoints, nonzero lower/upper integration controls, and the lazy-cofactorisation bound against a simulation. Does not rerun the full recurrence.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py, purge target 1e-4 U) at relation excess 1.05 (default; optional 'excess') and pool D's mean norms to mean weight 100, 200 or 300 (default 300) and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.87) and U/N. Optional (the hosted initial run is the bounded audit). Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).

Optional full recomputation of certificates, pools (replay of a block of judged-pool draws, region sums of pools B, C, D, the sizing rule), box bounds, region, ledger (v9 line table, wide-prime path and per-entry slice layout against the shipped callgrind logs, early abort, the mean + 2 SE filtering charge, weight-300 LA with five-vector Krylov kernels, eight-owner row tail), retention, ECM, lazy descent (with a simulation) and declared bounds (about 1.5 minutes natively).
